searchSummary: Expanded proper edge-coloring record across dynamic, W-streaming, LOCAL, MPC, line-graph LCA, and full-output graph-query oracles. Includes historical algorithms and later improvements, plus distinct palette (number of colors), update time versus recoloring recourse, random/adversarial edge order, simple versus multigraph, low-space MPC conditional lower bounds. q is a palette, not approximation ratio q/χ′. Query-oracle results explicitly compose edge enumeration with sequential algorithms; they do not assert sublinear query SOTA. LCA remains partial, because direct ordinary-graph oracle results were not verified. SOSA 2021, FOCS 2024 and SODA 2025 predecessor results are retained for navigation through progress.

coverage.note: Dynamic palette/update-time progression (2018–2026) with separate sparse-arboricity and forest recourse slices; randomized versus deterministic and amortized versus worst-case explicit.

One-pass adversarial and random-order W-stream, deterministic/randomized color/space tradeoffs and stronger online-color-commitment algorithm; unrestricted multi-pass streaming still open for curation.
Immediate colors, with edge arrivals, one-sided vertex arrivals, and random order kept apart.
Only one theorem-derived line-graph oracle LCA baseline was verified; direct edge-coloring LCAs under ordinary G neighbor probes are not yet sourced. Do not infer a frontier.
Historical and newer palettes (Δ+1, Δ+oΔ, ≈3Δ/2, 2Δ−2, 2Δ−1), randomized/deterministic bounds, one constant-degree multigraph slice. CONGEST stays distinct.
ESA 2019 linear local-space constant rounds and 2024 low-space deterministic specialized theorem plus conditional component-stable lower bound; no general low-space MPC optimality claim.
Adjacency-list/array slices are separated below; inspect each oracle and output assumption.
Adjacency-matrix slices are separated below; inspect pair-query and output assumptions.
No scoped records assigned to this access category yet.
A polynomial algorithm and the probability that the requested palette is impossible.
